title: 'Mashle: Sanma Taisou Shinkakusha Saishuu Shiken-hen' Reveals Additional Cast, Promo
content:
The official website of the Mashle ( Mashle: Magic and Muscles ) television anime revealed additional cast pair, a key visual and a promotional video for its third season on Wednesday. The new season is scheduled to premiere on January 10 at 12.00 a.m. on Tokyo MX, BS11, Gunma TV and Tochigi TV, followed by FBS Fukoka, Chukyo TV, Nagano Asahi, Okayama, Miyagi TV, Sapporo TV, Television Niigata and Chugoku.

Voice actors Souma Saitou ( Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e ) and Ryouta Suzuki ( Sakamoto Days ) are joining the cast as Domina Blowlive and Lévis Rosequartz, respectively.

Tomoya Tanaka ( Engage Kiss ) returns to direct the third season at A-1 Pictures . Yousuke Kuroda ( Boku no Hero Academia ) is handling series composition and penning the script. Chiaki Furuzumi ( Ore dake Level Up na Ken sub-character design) is designing the characters with Satoshi Motoyama ( Saigo ni Hitotsu dake Onegai shitemo Yoroshii deshou ka ) serving as sound director.

Mashle adapts Hajime Koumoto 's action comedy manga , which ran in Weekly Shounen Jump from January 2020 to July 2023. Shueisha published the 18th and final volume in October 2023.

VIZ Media simulpublished the manga in English and shipped the 18th and final volume in December 2024. Shueisha's Manga Plus platform also simulpublished the manga in English.

PV 1

title: Elden Ring: Distant Tales Between Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content:
Haruichi 's Elden Ring: Distant Tales Between ( Elden Ring: Tōki Hazama no Monogatari ) comedy manga , based on Bandai Namco and FromSoftware 's Elden Ring game, announced on October 19 that it will end in its next chapter. The manga did not reveal when that next chapter will debut, and the manga's webpage says the next chapter's scheduled launch is "to be determined."

The manga will end in its third volume, which was slated to ship on December 4.

Yen Press licensed the series, and it describes the story:

These are the tales of the other inhabitants of the Lands Between. What if Roderika were to befriend the rest of the Roundtable Hold? What if the Blackguard went in search of a new delicacy other than prawns? What if one were to catch a glimpse of Rya's youth? The lives of those in the Lands Between, and the many possibilities and the differing worlds that unfolded for them in the distant past, are written here.

Haruichi ( Star Wars: Visions , Star Wars Leia, Princess of Alderaan manga series) debuted the omnibus collection of short stories in July 2024.

FromSoftware launched the original Elden Ring game for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC via Steam in February 2022. The game quickly surpassed 12 million units in sales worldwide in March 2022, and had overtaken Call of Duty: Vanguard as the best-selling game in the U.S. in the last 12 months ending in April 2022. The game's DLC expansion Shadow of the Erdtree launched in June 2024 for PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam . The base Elden Ring game is required for the expansion. The DLC crossed 5 million copies in sales within its first three days of launch.

The game received a version for Nintendo Switch 2 titled Elden Ring : Tarnished Edition that released on August 28, delayed from its 2025 release. The Switch 2 version includes content from the DLC expansion Shadow of the Erdtree . The game also features new armor and a new customization for Torrent's appearance.

Hidetaka Miyazaki ( Dark Souls , Dark Souls III , Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice ) and author George R. R. Martin ( Game of Thrones ) collaborated in creating the original Elden Ring game's world.

The game is inspiring a live-action Hollywood film adaptation that will premiere on March 3, 2028.

title: Sayaka Mogi's Happy Hypoxia Manga Ends
content:
Futabasha 's Web Action manga website released the 15th and final chapter of Sayaka Mogi 's Happy Hypoxia -Haiiro no Ko- (Happy Hypoxia -The Grey Child-) manga on Tuesday.

The manga centers on Miyuki, a woman who has undergone fertility treatment for eight years and has just finally given birth. At the hospital, she meets Mirei, another woman who has just given birth. She expresses that she doesn't like how her own child or other people's babies look, leading Miyuki to think that Mirei didn't want to have her child. At that moment, a fire starts and begins to engulf the hospital, forcing Miyuki to make a desperate choice.

Mogi launched the manga in Futabasha 's Web Action manga website in June 2025. Futabasha published the manga's second compiled book volume on May 28.

Mogi launched the Kuroneko Sensei to Hotsureta Kanja-tachi (The Black Cat Doctor and the Frayed Patients) manga in September 2025. Hayakawa Publishing released the manga's first volume on June 24.

Mogi's Girl, Meat Girl "interspecies coming-of-age sci-fi" manga recently ended on February 13. Mogi launched the manga in Asahi Shimbun Publications ' Nemuki+ magazine in February 2023.

Mogi launched her horror manga Pupa in the inaugural issue of Comic Earth Star magazine in 2011, and ended it in December 2013. Earth Star Entertainment published five volumes for the manga. The manga inspired a 12-episode series of television anime shorts that premiered in January 2014.

Mogi launched the Red Riding Hood's Wolf Apprentice manga in Kodansha 's Bessatsu Shōnen Magazine in September 2017. Mogi published the end of the "first part" of the manga in December 2018, and announced that she would self-publish the rest of the manga. Kodansha published the manga's third compiled book volume in February 2019. Kodansha USA Publishing published the manga in English digitally, and it released the third volume in September 2019.

Mogi published the first volume of the Red Riding Hood's Wolf Apprentice: Final Testament to the Moon ( Akazukin no Ōkami Deshi - Tsuki e no Tsuigon ), the sequel manga of Red Riding Hood's Wolf Apprentice , at the Comitia dōjinshi event in Tokyo in May 2019. The digital version debuted in July 2019. Glacier Bay Books licensed the manga and published the first volume in English in print in May 2022. Digital manga service Azuki ( now Omoi ) added the manga in August 2022.

title: Unbreakable ~Yaburezaru Monotachi~ Manga Resumes With Final Arc Next Spring
content:
This year's 23rd issue of Akita Publishing 's Young Champion magazine announced on Tuesday that Tamaki Kaigane's manga adaptation of Kōji Yanagi 's Unbreakable ~Yaburezaru Monotachi~ (Unbreakable: The Undefeated) novel is entering its final arc and will move from the magazine to Akita Publishing 's YanChan Web platform next spring.

The story of the novel is set during the Peace Preservation Law of 1925, which targets those who believe in "Marxist" ideology. Proletarian writer Takiji Kobayashi chooses the harsh working conditions of a crab cannery ship as the subject of his next novel, which draws the attention of the special police task force charged with monitoring ideological threats. Two spies are sent to monitor his activities.

Kaigane launched the manga in Akita Publishing 's Young Champion magazine in August 2025. Akita Publishing shipped the first compiled book volume on June 19.

Kadokawa published the novel in 2024.

Yanagi published the original Joker Game novel in 2008. The novel won the Nihon Suiri Sakka Kyōkai-shō (Mystery Writers of Japan) award in 2009. Yū Irie directed a live-action adaptation of the novel, which premiered in Japan in January 2015. Yanagi followed up the original novel with three sequel novels — titled Double Joker , Paradise Lost , and Last Waltz — in 2009, 2012, and 2015, respectively. The series has more than 1.35 million copies in print.

Production I.G 's television anime adaptation of the Joker Game novel premiered in April 2016. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired in Japan, and Funimation streamed an English dub for the anime. Subaru Nitō launched the manga adaptation of the Joker Game anime in Mag Garden 's Comic Garden magazine in February 2016 and ended it in 2018. A stage play adaptation of the anime opened in 2017, with a second stage play in 2018.

title: Black Clover Season 2 New Noelle Battle Visual Spotlights Her Valkyrie Dress Form
content:
Black Clover Season 2 revealed its second “Most Fearsome Battle Visual,” this time featuring Noelle Silva. The visual shows Noelle after forming a contract with Undine and activating the Saint Valkyrie Dress.

The visual is the second entry in the campaign, while the first visual featured Asta in his Devil Union form . The project is built around the concept of showing characters at the moment an enemy is about to face their attack, with additional battle visuals planned for other characters.

The new Noelle visual was released after Episode 6 , in which Noelle showed off her Saint Stage magic and fought Vanica. You can check it out below.

The character design for Megicula was also revealed:

The main staff for Season 2 includes:

• Director: Ayataka Tanemura

• Series Composition: Keiichiro Ochi

• Character Design: Itsuko Takeda

• Sub-Character Design: Kumiko Tokunaga

• Prop Design: Kosei Takahashi

• Music: Minako Seki

• Animation Production: Studio Pierrot

The opening song by WANIMA is titled “Kienai Riyuu” (The Reason That Won’t Disappear).

ALSO READ: Black Clover Creator Draws Toru Oikawa From Haikyu!! Interview: Asta Voice Actors Gakuto Kajiwara and Dallas Reid on Black Clover Season 2

You can also see the main visual .

The Black Clover manga was serialized in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2015 to August 2023, before transferring to Jump GIGA . It entered its final arc in August 2022 and officially ended on May 1 after eleven years of serialization. The manga is available to read on Viz Media’s website, MANGA Plus website, and the Shonen Jump mobile app in English.

It received a 170-episode anime adaptation by Studio Pierrot, which ran from 2017 to 2021. The Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King movie premiered on June 16 and is streaming on Netflix. Crunchyroll streams the TV anime, and they describe the story:

In a world where magic is everything, Asta and Yuno are both found abandoned at a church on the same day. While Yuno is gifted with exceptional magical powers, Asta is the only one in this world without any. At the age of fifteen, both receive grimoires, magic books that amplify their holder’s magic. Asta’s is a rare Grimoire of Anti-Magic that negates and repels his opponent’s spells. Being opposite but good rivals, Yuno and Asta are ready for the hardest of challenges to achieve their common dream: to be the Wizard King. Giving up is never an option!

title: Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3's New Video Unveils More Cast & Staff, January 9 Debut
content:
Aniplex presented the first full promotional video, a new key visual, a character visual, and a birthday visual for Mashle: Magic and Muscles - Tri-Magicathalon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc , the third season based on Hajime Kōmoto 's Mashle: Magic and Muscles manga, on Wednesday. (Wednesday is also Mash's birthday.) The video announces more cast and staff members, and the January 9 premiere for the new season.

The newly announced cast members are:

• Sōma Saitō as Domina Blowelive

• Ryōta Suzuki as Lévis Rosequartz

The newly announced staff members are:

• Assistant Director: Kazuya Ishiguri

• Sub-Character Design: Kento Toya

• Prop Design: Akane Hirose, Yutori Sugiura.

• Monster Design: Mayuko Yamamoto

• Color Key Artist: Azusa Sasaki

• Art Setting: Hideyasu Narita

• Art Director: Ayano Okamoto

• Compositing Director of Photography: Akihito Suzuki

• CG Director: Manabu Asakawa

• Editing: Masato Yoshitake

• Sound Director: Satoshi Motoyama

• Sound Effects: Yui Andō

• Sound Production: INSPION Edge

The season will premiere on the Tokyo MX , BS11 , Gunma TV , and Tochigi TV channels on January 9 at 24:00 (effectively, January 10 at midnight). It will also run on 10 other channels in Japan, as well as ABEMA , d Anime Store , and other streaming platforms.

Returning cast members include:

• Chiaki Kobayashi as Mash Burnedead

• Kaito Ishikawa as Lance Crown

• Reiji Kawashima as Finn Ames

• Reina Ueda as Lemon Irvine

• Takuya Eguchi as Dot Barrett

Confirmed returning staff members include director Tomoya Tanaka at A-1 Pictures , series script supervisor and scriptwriter Yōsuke Kuroda , and composer Masaru Yokoyama . Chiaki Furuzumi (chief animation director and sub-character designer for Solo Leveling both seasons) is replacing Hisashi Higashijima as the character designer.

The anime's first season premiered in Japan in April 2023 and aired for 12 episodes. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, and it streamed an English dub . The second season premiered in January 2024 and aired for 12 episodes. Crunchyroll again streamed the series as it aired and streamed an English dub .

The overall anime project is listed as a "complete" anime adaptation. Crunchyroll will stream the third season.

Both Viz Media 's Shonen Jump service and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service published the manga digitally in English. Viz Media is also releasing the manga in print. Shueisha describes the manga:

This is a world of magic where magic is used for everything. But deep in the forest exists a young man who spends his time training and bulking up. He can't use magic, but he enjoys a peaceful life with his father. But one day, his life is put in danger! Will his muscular body protect him from the magic users who are out to get him? Powerfully trained muscles crush magic as this abnormal magical fantasy begins!

The series launched in Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in Japan in January 2020, and ended in July 2023. Shueisha published the manga's 18th and final compiled book volume, as well as a fanbook, in October 2023. The franchise also includes several novels and two stage play adaptations .

Mackenyu Maeda is starring in a live-action film adaptation that will open on MArch 19, 2027.

Mashle : Muscle Puzzle , a smartphone puzzle game in the franchise , launched in April 2025.

title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Spotlights Stands in New Special Video
content:
STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure has released a new Stand special video featuring previously unseen footage from the ongoing anime. The video titled “HERE COME THE STANDS” focuses on the Stands introduced so far and showcases several of their abilities through new cuts. Warner Bros. Japan also teased additional Stand battles that will appear as the story continues.

You can watch the new video below.

You can also watch the Japanese version of the video below.

Steel Ball Run is the seventh part of Hirohiko Araki’s legendary JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure manga. Set in late 19th-century America, the story follows former prodigy jockey Johnny Joestar and mysterious outlaw Gyro Zeppeli as they compete in a transcontinental horse race for a massive cash prize. Beneath the surface, however, they face dangerous conspiracies that threaten to take over the competition. The first episode was a 47-minute special covering Stage 1 of the race, and it released on March 19, 2026.

The manga by Hirohiro Araki began in 1987, while the Steel Ball Run part ran from 2004 to 2011. The full staff for the latest anime installment includes:

• Director: Yasuhiro Kimura & Hideya Takahashi (Golden Wind)

• Series Director: Toshiyuki Kato (Every Series)

• Series Structure: Yasuko Kobayashi (Every Series)

• Character Design: Daisuke Tsumagari (Golden Wind)

• Music: Yugo Kanno (Stardust Crusaders, Diamond is Unbreakable, Golden Wind, Stone Ocean)

• Sound Director: Yoshikazu Iwanami (Every Series)

• Animation: david production (Every Series)

You can also see the key visual for the 2nd STAGE.

title: Mashle Season 3 Reveals First Main Trailer and New Key Visual, January 9 Premiere
content:
Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3 TV anime revealed the first main and new key visual, along with a January 9, 2027 premiere date. The anime was first announced as a sequel project , with the format confirmed to be a TV anime at last year’s Jump Festa . It will go into the Tri-Magic-Athalon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc . The new trailer introduces Domina Blowelive and Levi Rosequartz, with their voice actors also announced:

• Ryota Suzuki as Levi Rosequartz

• Soma Saito as Domina Blowelive

The full staff includes:

• Director: Tomonari Tanaka

• Assistant Director: Kazuya Ishiguri

• Series Composition / Screenplay: Yosuke Kuroda

• Character Design: Chiaki Furuzumi

• Sub Character Design: Kento Toya

• Prop Design: Akane Hirose, Yutori Sugiura

• Monster Design: Mayuko Yamamoto

• Color Setting: Azusa Sasaki

• Art Setting: Hideyasu Narita

• Art Director: Ayano Okamoto

• Director of Photography: Akihito Suzuki

• CG Director: Manabu Asakawa

• Editor: Masato Yoshitake

• Music: Masaru Yokoyama

• Sound Director: Satoshi Motoyama

• Sound Effects: Yui Ando

• Sound Production: INSPION EDGE

• Animation Production: A-1 Pictures

Also check out the new key visual:

A teaser visual featuring Domina Blowelive was previously revealed.

You can also see the teaser visual featuring Mash below.

The first season of Mashle: Magic and Muscles ended in June after running for 12 episodes. The second season also ran for 12 episodes in Winter 2024 and covered the Divine Visionary Selection Exam Arc . The next in the manga is the Tri-Magic-Athalon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc .

The voice cast for the Mashle anime adaptation includes:

• Chiaki Kobayashi as Mash Burnedead

• Kaito Ishikawa as Lance Crown

• Takuya Eguchi as Dot Barrett

• Reiji Kawashima as Finn Ames

• Reina Ueda as Lemon Irvine

• Yuki Kaji as Rayne Ames

• Yuichiro Umehara as Abel Walker

• Hiroki Nanami as Abyss Razor

Hajime Komoto writes and draws the Mashle manga, which was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from January 2020 until July 2023. VIZ licensed it in English, and you can also read it on MANGA Plus. The platform describes the story as: This is a world of magic where magic is used for everything. But deep in the forest exists a young man who spends his time training and bulking up. He can’t use magic, but he enjoys a peaceful life with his father. But one day, his life is put in danger! Will his muscular body protect him from the magic users who are out to get him? Powerfully trained muscles crush magic as this abnormal magical fantasy begins!
author: Anime Corner

title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter Anime's New Video Reveals Ending Song
content:
The staff for the television anime of writer Sinnoa 's SSS-Class Revival Hunter web novel and adaptor Neida and artist Bill K 's webtoon revealed the anime's ending theme song "Fading" by THE SPELLBOUND × BOOM BOOM SATELLITES groups in a new promotional video, on Wednesday.

Crunchyroll describes the story:

A mysterious tower crawling with monsters has suddenly appeared, drawing Hunters willing to risk their lives for glory and riches. Gongja Kim, a weak F-rank Hunter, spends his days envying the Flame Emperor who reigns as the top Hunter. But his chance at greatness finally arrives when he joins forces with the Sword Emperor and gains a rare S-rank skill, with one catch: he must die to activate it.

The anime stars:

• Takeo Ōtsuka as Gongja Kim (listed as Yeon-ja Kim on the anime's website)

• Satoshi Hino as the Sword Emperor

• Toshiki Masuda as Flame Emperor

• Megumi Han as Witch of the Black Dragon

• Sayaka Kinoshita as Paladin

• Risa Shimizu as Countess

• Makoto Furukawa as Poisonous Viper

• Natsumi Fujiwara as Inquisitor

• Yuka Iguchi as Master Alchemist

• Shunsuke Sakuya as Blade Saint

Hiroaki Sakurai ( The Demon Girl Next Door ) is directing the anime at Studio fu . Sayuri Ōba ( Romantic Killer ) is writing the script. Takahiro Yoshimatsu ( Trigun ) is designing the characters. HAYATE is producing the series. Ryo Kawasaki ( To Your Eternity three seasons, Romantic Killer ) and Tomoyuki Kono ( A Few Moments of Cheers , Romantic Killer ) are composing the music.

The anime will debut in January on Fuji TV 's +Ultra programming block. Crunchyroll will stream the anime worldwide, excluding Asia, with availability in the Indian subcontinent, Indonesia, Singapore, the Philippines, and Malaysia.

The original novel debuted in November 2018, and the webtoon launched in December 2020. Tapas publishes the webtoon in English digitally, and Ize Press is releasing the series in print. WuxiaWorld publishes the web novel in English.
author: ANN

title: Tomoko Ninomiya's Nanatsu-ya: Shinobu and Her Jewelry Box Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
A website opened on Wednesday to announce the television anime adaptation of Tomoko Ninomiya 's Nanatsu-ya: Shinobu and Her Jewelry Box ( Nanatsuya Shinobu no Hōsekibako ) manga. The website also revealed the anime's teaser trailer, teaser visual, main staff members, and 2027 debut.

Ninomiya also drew an illustration to celebrate the announcement:

Kodansha 's K MANGA service publishes the manga in English and describes the story:

Shinobu, a second-year in high school, is part of the family that runs Kurata-ya, a storied pawn shop based in a breezy central Tokyo neighborhood. She helps run the place when school isn't calling, and she has a natural gift that aids her a great deal—the ability to see the “aura” released by gemstones! Shinobu doesn't have a boyfriend, but she does have a fiancé handpicked for her by her grandfather—Akisada Kitagami, a man from a prestigious family who wound up being taken in by Kurata-ya at a young age. He now works as a salesman for a first-class jewelry brand, but he's also got more than his fair share of secrets...

Chiaki Kon ( Nodame Cantabile: Finale , Nodame Cantabile: Paris , The Way of the Househusband ) is directing the anime at J.C.STAFF . Seishi Minakami ( A Certain Scientific Railgun , Sugar Apple Fairy Tale , Sacrificial Princess & the King of Beasts ) is in charge of series scripts, and Mai Furuki ( I.Cinnamoroll , Mewkledreamy ) is designing the characters.

Ninomiya launched the ongoing manga in Kodansha 's Kiss magazine in November 2013, and Kodansha will publish the manga's 28th compiled book volume on November 13.

The manga had gone on several hiatuses from 2018-2019 due to the author's health.

Ninomiya launched her Nodame Cantabile manga in Kiss magazine in 2001, and ended it in 2009. Del Rey published 16 volumes of the manga in North America until the publisher ceased releasing manga. Kodansha USA Publishing later published all 25 volumes in English digitally. The manga was adapted into three television anime series , and has also received live-action drama and film adaptations .
author: ANN
